errata.was: 'a separate testimonium preserves ἀλλὰ πᾶν τόλματον'; the lost stanza called the fourth; 'γράμματα + μολπά is attested in fr. 44.33, fr. 147'
errata.now: Version 2.3 (#1774): the line stands inside Longinus's quotation at the fifth position; καὶ πένητα is obelized and assigned by Bergk to Longinus; no attestation of the collocation is claimed, and γράμματα is marked as a fifth-century word.
